<pasted_content id="92b0">
ummary
Add a shared way for a report to tell whether its current settings differ from the saved widget, and a "(modified)" label that matches the one Custom Reports use. Wire both into eight reports: Net Worth, Cash Flow, Spending, Summary, Crossover, Age of Money, Calendar and Goal.

User Story
As a user who edits Net Worth, Cash Flow, Spending, Summary, Crossover, Age of Money, Calendar or Goal widgets, I want to see a "(modified)" label when my changes aren't saved so that I know to press Save widget before leaving.

User Scenario
On the dashboard, the user opens a Net Worth widget.
They change the date range. "(modified)" appears next to the widget name.
They change the date range back to the saved value. The label disappears.
They add an account filter. The label reappears. They press Save widget, and the label disappears again.
Acceptance Criteria
Given any of the eight reports opened from a widget, when the user changes a setting that Save widget would save, then "(modified)" appears next to the widget name.
Given a report showing "(modified)", when the user presses Save widget and the save succeeds, then the label disappears. If the save fails, the label stays.
Given a report showing "(modified)", when the user changes every setting back to its saved value, then the label disappears.
Given a report opened without a widget (for example /reports/net-worth, which has no Save widget button), then the label never appears.
Given the Goal report, when the user only renames the widget with the inline name editor (which saves right away), then the label does not appear.
Each of the eight reports has a unit test showing that the settings checked for changes are exactly the settings Save widget writes.
Out of Scope
The Formula and experimental reports (Show a "(modified)" label on the Formula and experimental report widgets #126).
Custom Reports, which already have this label.
Any dialog or prompt when leaving the page, and any change to App.tsx or the router (see the Design section in Show when a report widget has unsaved changes #96).
Open Questions
Spending and Calendar can use relative date ranges such as "this month". Should a widget saved as "this month" show as modified next month, when the actual dates have moved? (Proposed: no. Compare the saved range setting, not the dates it resolves to.)
Should Save widget be disabled when there are no changes? (Proposed: no. Leave it as it is, to keep this change small and unsurprising.)
Scope
Medium: building the shared helper and label is a small part of the work. Most of it is reworking each of the eight reports so the same function builds both what Save widget saves and what gets compared, plus a test per report.
</pasted_content id="92b0">

```text
411	// Interval selector component with icon-only trigger similar to filter button
412	function IntervalSelector({
413	  interval,
414	  onChange,
415	}: {
416	  interval: 'Daily' | 'Weekly' | 'Monthly' | 'Yearly';
417	  onChange: (val: 'Daily' | 'Weekly' | 'Monthly' | 'Yearly') => void;
418	}) {
419	  const { t } = useTranslation();
420	
421	  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
422	  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
423	
424	  const currentLabel =
425	    ReportOptions.interval.find(opt => opt.key === interval)?.description ??
426	    interval;
427	
428	  return (
429	    <>
430	      <Button
431	        ref={triggerRef}
432	        variant="bare"
433	        onPress={() => setIsOpen(true)}
434	        aria-label={t('Change interval')}
435	      >
436	        <SvgCalendar style={{ width: 12, height: 12 }} />
437	        <span style={{ marginLeft: 5 }}>{currentLabel}</span>
438	      </Button>
439	
440	      <Popover
441	        triggerRef={triggerRef}
442	        placement="bottom start"
443	        isOpen={isOpen}
444	        onOpenChange={() => setIsOpen(false)}
445	      >
446	        <Menu
447	          onMenuSelect={item => {
448	            onChange(item as 'Daily' | 'Weekly' | 'Monthly' | 'Yearly');
449	            setIsOpen(false);
450	          }}
451	          items={ReportOptions.interval.map(({ key, description }) => ({
452	            name: key as 'Daily' | 'Weekly' | 'Monthly' | 'Yearly',
453	            text: description,
454	          }))}
455	        />
456	      </Popover>
457	    </>
```

```text
title:	Show when a report widget has unsaved changes
state:	OPEN
author:	TigerK9 (Liam McLemore)
labels:	scope: large
comments:	1
assignees:	
projects:	
milestone:	
issue-type:	Feature
parent:	
sub-issues:	CSCI-435-SE/actual-budget#125, CSCI-435-SE/actual-budget#126
sub-issues-completed:	0/2
blocked-by:	
blocking:	
number:	96
--
### Summary

When you change a report's filters, date range or display options and then leave without pressing **Save widget**, Actual drops the changes, and nothing on the page tells you they were unsaved. Custom Reports already show "(modified)" next to the report name when they have unsaved edits; the other 13 dashboard widget reports don't. This epic adds the same "(modified)" label to every widget report, so users can see at a glance that they have something to save.

### User Story

As a budget user who customizes dashboard reports, I want to see when a report has unsaved changes so that I remember to press **Save widget** before leaving.

### Sub-issues

- [ ] #125 — Show a "(modified)" label on the standard report widgets
- [ ] #126 — Show a "(modified)" label on the Formula and experimental report widgets

### Scope

Large as a whole: 13 report pages each need their own change detection. It's split into two medium sub-issues.

### Source

While reviewing the goal-card widget PRs, I noticed that leaving the card without saving silently drops your changes. None of the other reports warn you either.

### Design

**Decision: show that changes are unsaved, instead of blocking the user from leaving.**

The original version of this issue proposed a "Save / Discard / Cancel" dialog that would appear whenever the user tried to leave a report with unsaved changes. We considered three options:

- _Option A: block every way of leaving._ This would catch the <kbd>Esc</kbd> key, sidebar links, the browser back/forward buttons and closing the tab, using React Router's `useBlocker`. The catch is that `useBlocker` only works with React Router's newer "data router" setup, and `App.tsx` currently sets up routing with `<BrowserRouter>`. We would first have to change how `App.tsx` sets up routing for the entire app, not just reports.
- _Option B: block only the <kbd>Esc</kbd> key and the page's own back controls._ This needs no change to `App.tsx`, but it misses the sidebar and the browser back button, which are the most common ways to leave a page.
- _Option C (chosen): don't block at all._ Show a "(modified)" label next to the widget name while its settings differ from what's saved, matching what Custom Reports already do.

**Rationale.** Option A meant restructuring `App.tsx`, the root of the whole app. That change would affect every page, break existing tests that render components with `<MemoryRouter>`, and have to be finished before any report work could start, so one stalled PR could block the whole team. That's a lot of risk for a small feature, and Actual's maintainers would be unlikely to accept an app-wide routing change made for this reason. A blocking dialog also gets in the way of normal use: people often open a report just to look something up, change the dates, and leave without wanting to save. Option C needs no change to `App.tsx`, doesn't interrupt anyone, and matches behavior users already know from Custom Reports.

**Consequences.**

- Users can still leave without saving. The label tells them, but nothing stops them.
- The browser back button and closing the tab are not covered. If users ask for a real "are you sure?" prompt later, the routing change in `App.tsx` can be revisited as its own issue.
- The change-detection helper built in #125 is reusable, so any future prompt would only need to add the dialog.

### Summary

Use the helper and label from #125 on the five remaining widget reports: Formula, Sankey, Budget Analysis, Balance Forecast and Monte Carlo. The last four are experimental and only appear when their feature flag is on in **Settings → Experimental features**.

### User Story

As a user building Formula widgets or trying the experimental reports, I want to see a "(modified)" label when my changes aren't saved so that I don't lose settings that took effort to set up, such as formulas or simulation inputs.

### User Scenario

A user turns on the Monte Carlo experimental feature and opens a Monte Carlo widget. They change the simulation inputs, and "(modified)" appears next to the widget name. They press **Save widget**, and the label disappears.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. **Given** any of the five reports opened from a widget, **when** the user changes a setting that **Save widget** would save, **then** "(modified)" appears next to the widget name. Saving successfully, or changing the setting back, removes it.
2. **Given** a Formula widget, **when** the user edits the formula text without saving, **then** the label appears.
3. **Given** Balance Forecast or Monte Carlo, which write to the saved widget from more than one place in their code, **when** one of those other saves happens, **then** the label reflects the newly saved settings and is not stuck on "(modified)". A unit test covers this.
4. **Given** a report whose feature flag is off, **then** nothing about the app's behavior changes.

### Out of Scope

- The reports covered by #125.
- Taking any report out of experimental status.
- Any dialog or prompt when leaving the page.
```

```text
601	type SumWithRangeProps = {
602	  from: string;
603	  to: string;
604	  containerStyle?: CSSProperties;
605	  filterObject: FilterObject;
606	};
607	function SumWithRange({
608	  from,
609	  to,
610	  containerStyle,
611	  filterObject,
612	}: SumWithRangeProps) {
613	  const { t } = useTranslation();
614	  const { isNarrowWidth } = useResponsive();
615	  const sigmaSize = isNarrowWidth ? 34 : 50;
616	  // The range labels hang outside the sigma column; `nowrap` keeps them off the glyph.
617	  const rangeLabelStyle = {
618	    position: 'absolute',
619	    right: -30,
620	    fontSize: isNarrowWidth ? '11px' : undefined,
621	    whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
622	  } satisfies CSSProperties;
623	  const rangeLabelOffset = isNarrowWidth ? -14 : -20;
624	  const sigmaColumnWidth = isNarrowWidth ? sigmaSize : 70;
625	  const conditionsMargin = isNarrowWidth ? 8 : 16;
626	
627	  return (
628	    <View
629	      style={{
630	        ...containerStyle,
631	        height: '100%',
632	        flexDirection: 'row',
633	        alignItems: 'center',
634	        position: 'relative',
635	        display: 'grid',
636	        gridTemplateColumns: `${sigmaColumnWidth}px 15px 1fr 15px`,
637	      }}
638	    >
639	      <View

641	          position: 'relative',
642	          height: sigmaSize,
643	          marginRight: isNarrowWidth ? 28 : 50,
644	        }}
645	      >
646	        <SvgSum width={sigmaSize} height={sigmaSize} />
647	        <Text style={{ ...rangeLabelStyle, top: rangeLabelOffset }}>{to}</Text>
648	        <Text style={{ ...rangeLabelStyle, bottom: rangeLabelOffset }}>

650	        </Text>
651	      </View>
652	      <SvgOpenParenthesis width={15} style={{ height: '100%' }} />
653	      <View
654	        style={{

656	          maxWidth: isNarrowWidth ? '150px' : '220px',
657	          marginRight: conditionsMargin,
658	        }}
659	      >
```

```text
174	  useEffect(() => {
175	    async function run() {
176	      const earliestTransactionData = await send('get-earliest-transaction');
177	
178	      const currentMonth = monthUtils.currentMonth();
179	      const previousMonth = monthUtils.subMonths(currentMonth, 1);
180	
181	      // Set earliest transaction date
182	      const earliestDate = earliestTransactionData
183	        ? earliestTransactionData.date
184	        : monthUtils.firstDayOfMonth(previousMonth);
185	      setEarliestTransaction(earliestDate);
186	
187	      // Set latest transaction date, ensuring it doesn't include current month
188	      const latestDate = monthUtils.lastDayOfMonth(previousMonth);
189	      setLatestTransaction(latestDate);
190	
191	      const allMonths = monthUtils
192	        .rangeInclusive(earliestDate, latestDate)
193	        .map(month => ({
194	          name: month,
195	          pretty: monthUtils.format(month, 'MMMM yyyy', locale),
196	        }))
197	        .reverse();
198	
199	      setAllMonths(allMonths);
200	    }
201	    void run();
202	  }, [locale]);
203	
204	  useEffect(() => {
205	    if (latestTransaction && allMonths?.length) {
206	      const [initialStart, initialEnd, mode] = calculateTimeRange(
207	        widget?.meta?.timeFrame,
208	        defaultTimeFrame,
209	        latestTransaction,
210	      );
211	      const earliestMonth = allMonths[allMonths.length - 1].name;
212	      const latestMonth = allMonths[0].name;
213	      let start = initialStart;
214	      let end = initialEnd;
215	
216	      const clampMonth = (m: string) => {
217	        if (monthUtils.isBefore(m, earliestMonth)) return earliestMonth;
218	        if (monthUtils.isAfter(m, latestMonth)) return latestMonth;
219	        return m;
220	      };
221	
222	      // For both sliding-window and full modes, ensure end doesn't include current month
223	      if (mode === 'sliding-window') {
224	        // Shift both start and end back one month for sliding-window
225	        start = clampMonth(monthUtils.subMonths(start, 1));
226	        end = clampMonth(monthUtils.subMonths(end, 1));
227	      } else if (mode === 'full') {
228	        start = earliestMonth;
229	        end = latestMonth;
230	      } else {
231	        start = clampMonth(start);
232	        end = clampMonth(end);
233	      }
234	      if (monthUtils.isBefore(end, start)) {
235	        end = start;
236	      }
237	      setStart(start);
238	      setEnd(end);
239	      setMode(mode);
240	    }
241	  }, [latestTransaction, widget?.meta?.timeFrame, allMonths]);
242	
243	  function onChangeDates(start: string, end: string, mode: TimeFrame['mode']) {
244	    if (!allMonths?.length) {
245	      return;
246	    }
247	    const earliestMonth = allMonths[allMonths.length - 1].name;
248	    const latestMonth = allMonths[0].name;
249	
250	    const clampMonth = (m: string) => {
251	      if (monthUtils.isBefore(m, earliestMonth)) return earliestMonth;
252	      if (monthUtils.isAfter(m, latestMonth)) return latestMonth;
253	      return m;
254	    };
255	
256	    // For both sliding-window and full modes, ensure end doesn't include current month
257	    if (mode === 'sliding-window') {
258	      // Shift both start and end back one month for sliding-window
259	      start = clampMonth(monthUtils.subMonths(start, 1));
260	      end = clampMonth(monthUtils.subMonths(end, 1));
261	    } else if (mode === 'full') {
262	      start = earliestMonth;
263	      end = latestMonth;
264	    } else {
265	      start = clampMonth(start);
266	      end = clampMonth(end);
267	    }
268	    if (monthUtils.isBefore(end, start)) {
269	      end = start;
270	    }
271	    setStart(start);
272	    setEnd(end);
273	    setMode(mode);
274	  }
```

```text
5	export function validateStart(
6	  earliest: string,
7	  latest: string,
8	  start: string,
9	  end: string,
10	  interval?: string,
11	  firstDayOfWeekIdx?: SyncedPrefs['firstDayOfWeekIdx'],
12	): [string, string, TimeFrame['mode']] {
13	  let addDays: number;
14	  let dateStart: string;
15	  switch (interval) {
16	    case 'Monthly':
17	      dateStart = start + '-01';
18	      addDays = 180;
19	      break;
20	    case 'Yearly':
21	      dateStart = start + '-01-01';
22	      addDays = 1095;
23	      break;
24	    case 'Daily':
25	      dateStart = start;
26	      addDays = 6;
27	      break;
28	    default:
29	      dateStart = start;
30	      addDays = 180;
31	      break;
32	  }
33	
34	  if (end < start) {
35	    end = monthUtils.addDays(dateStart, addDays);
36	  }
37	  return boundedRange(
38	    earliest,
39	    latest,
40	    dateStart,
41	    interval ? end : monthUtils.monthFromDate(end),
42	    interval,
43	    firstDayOfWeekIdx,
44	  );
45	}

47	export function validateEnd(
48	  earliest: string,
49	  latest: string,

60	      subDays = 180;

62	    case 'Yearly':
63	      dateEnd = end + '-12-31';
64	      subDays = 1095;
65	      break;
66	    case 'Daily':
67	      dateEnd = end;
68	      subDays = 6;
69	      break;
70	    default:
71	      dateEnd = end;

89	export function validateRange(
90	  earliest: string,
91	  start: string,
92	  end: string,

95	    start = earliest;
96	  }

101	export function boundMonthRange(
102	  earliestMonth: string,
103	  latestMonth: string,
104	  startMonth: string,
105	  endMonth: string,
106	): [string, string] {
107	  let boundedStart = startMonth;
108	  let boundedEnd = endMonth;
109	
110	  if (monthUtils.isBefore(boundedStart, earliestMonth)) {
111	    boundedStart = earliestMonth;
112	  } else if (monthUtils.isAfter(boundedStart, latestMonth)) {
113	    boundedStart = latestMonth;
114	  }
115	
116	  if (monthUtils.isBefore(boundedEnd, earliestMonth)) {
117	    boundedEnd = earliestMonth;
118	  } else if (monthUtils.isAfter(boundedEnd, latestMonth)) {
119	    boundedEnd = latestMonth;
120	  }
121	
122	  if (monthUtils.isBefore(boundedEnd, boundedStart)) {
123	    boundedEnd = boundedStart;
124	  }
125	
126	  return [boundedStart, boundedEnd];
127	}
128	
129	export function boundMonthRangeFromDates(
130	  earliestDate: string,
131	  latestDate: string,
132	  start: string,
133	  end: string,
134	): [string, string] {
135	  return boundMonthRange(
136	    monthUtils.getMonth(earliestDate),
137	    monthUtils.getMonth(latestDate),
138	    monthUtils.getMonth(start),
139	    monthUtils.getMonth(end),
140	  );
141	}
142	
143	function boundedRange(
144	  earliest: string,
145	  latest: string,
146	  start: string,
147	  end: string,
148	  interval?: string,
149	  _firstDayOfWeekIdx?: SyncedPrefs['firstDayOfWeekIdx'],
150	): [string, string, 'static'] {
151	  switch (interval) {
152	    case 'Daily':
153	      latest = monthUtils.currentDay();
154	      break;
155	    case 'Weekly':
156	      // For weekly views, clamp to today so the current (ongoing) week is included
157	      // and reflects data up to the current day.
158	      latest = monthUtils.currentDay();
159	      break;
160	    case 'Monthly':
161	      latest = monthUtils.getMonthEnd(monthUtils.currentDay());
162	      break;
163	    case 'Yearly':
164	      latest = monthUtils.currentDay();
165	      break;
166	    default:
167	      break;
168	  }
169	
170	  if (end > latest) {
171	    end = latest;
172	  }
173	  if (start < earliest) {
174	    start = earliest;
175	  }
176	  return [start, end, 'static'];
177	}
178	
179	export function getSpecificRange(
180	  offset: number,
181	  addNumber: number | null,
182	  type?: string,
183	  firstDayOfWeekIdx?: SyncedPrefs['firstDayOfWeekIdx'],
184	) {
185	  const currentDay = monthUtils.currentDay();
186	  const currentWeek = monthUtils.currentWeek(firstDayOfWeekIdx);
187	
188	  let dateStart = monthUtils.subMonths(currentDay, offset) + '-01';
189	  let dateEnd = monthUtils.getMonthEnd(
190	    monthUtils.addMonths(dateStart, addNumber === null ? offset : addNumber) +
191	      '-01',
192	  );
193	
194	  if (type === 'Week') {
195	    dateStart = monthUtils.subWeeks(currentWeek, offset);
196	    dateEnd = monthUtils.getWeekEnd(
197	      monthUtils.addWeeks(dateStart, addNumber === null ? offset : addNumber),
198	      firstDayOfWeekIdx,
199	    );
200	  }
201	
202	  return [dateStart, dateEnd, 'static'];
203	}
204	
205	export function getFullRange(start: string, end: string) {
206	  return [start, end, 'full'] as const;
207	}
208	
209	export function getLatestRange(offset: number) {
210	  const end = monthUtils.currentMonth();
211	  const start = monthUtils.subMonths(end, offset);
212	
213	  return [start, end, 'sliding-window'] as const;
214	}
215	
216	export function getNextRange(offset: number) {
217	  const start = monthUtils.currentMonth();
218	  const end = monthUtils.addMonths(start, offset);
219	
220	  return [start, end, 'static'] as const;
221	}
222	
223	export function getFullFutureRange(latestMonth?: string) {
224	  const start = monthUtils.currentMonth();
225	  const defaultEnd = monthUtils.addMonths(start, 24);
226	  const end =
227	    latestMonth && monthUtils.isAfter(latestMonth, start)
228	      ? latestMonth
229	      : defaultEnd;
230	
231	  return [start, end, 'static'] as const;
232	}
233	
234	// For month-granular consumers (e.g. formula queries): collapse day-shaped
235	// bounds so a live range keeps sliding by whole months rather than days.
236	export function asMonthSlidingTimeFrame(
237	  timeFrame: Partial<TimeFrame>,
238	): Partial<TimeFrame> {
239	  const { start, end, mode } = timeFrame;
240	  if (mode !== 'sliding-window' || !start || !end) {
241	    return timeFrame;
242	  }
243	  return {
244	    ...timeFrame,
245	    start: monthUtils.getMonth(start),
246	    end: monthUtils.getMonth(end),
247	  };
248	}
249	
250	export function calculateTimeRange(
251	  timeFrame?: Partial<TimeFrame>,
252	  defaultTimeFrame?: TimeFrame,
253	  latestTransaction?: string,
254	) {
255	  const start =
256	    timeFrame?.start ??
257	    defaultTimeFrame?.start ??
258	    monthUtils.subMonths(monthUtils.currentMonth(), 5);
259	  const end =
260	    timeFrame?.end ?? defaultTimeFrame?.end ?? monthUtils.currentMonth();
261	  const mode = timeFrame?.mode ?? defaultTimeFrame?.mode ?? 'sliding-window';
262	
263	  if (mode === 'full') {
264	    const latestTransactionMonth = latestTransaction
265	      ? monthUtils.monthFromDate(latestTransaction)
266	      : null;
267	    const currentMonth = monthUtils.currentMonth();
268	    const fullEnd =
269	      latestTransactionMonth &&
270	      monthUtils.isAfter(latestTransactionMonth, currentMonth)
271	        ? latestTransactionMonth
272	        : currentMonth;
273	    return getFullRange(start, fullEnd);
274	  }
275	  if (mode === 'sliding-window') {
276	    // Day-shaped ranges slide by days: same width, ending today.
277	    if (
278	      monthUtils.isValidYearMonthDay(start) &&
279	      monthUtils.isValidYearMonthDay(end)
280	    ) {
281	      const dayOffset = monthUtils.differenceInCalendarDays(end, start);
282	      const today = monthUtils.currentDay();
283	      return [
284	        monthUtils.subDays(today, Math.max(dayOffset, 0)),
285	        today,
286	        'sliding-window',
287	      ] as const;
288	    }
289	
290	    const offset = monthUtils.differenceInCalendarMonths(end, start);
291	
292	    if (start > end) {
293	      return [
294	        monthUtils.currentMonth(),
295	        monthUtils.subMonths(monthUtils.currentMonth(), -offset),
296	        'sliding-window',
297	      ] as const;
298	    }
299	
300	    return getLatestRange(offset);
301	  }
302	  if (mode === 'lastMonth') {
303	    const lastMonth = monthUtils.subMonths(monthUtils.currentMonth(), 1);
304	    return [lastMonth, lastMonth, 'lastMonth'] as const;
305	  }
306	  if (mode === 'lastYear') {
307	    return [
308	      monthUtils.getYearStart(monthUtils.prevYear(monthUtils.currentMonth())),
309	      monthUtils.getYearEnd(monthUtils.prevYear(monthUtils.currentDate())),
310	      'lastYear',
311	    ] as const;
312	  }
313	  if (mode === 'yearToDate') {
314	    return [
315	      monthUtils.currentYear() + '-01',
316	      monthUtils.currentMonth(),
317	      'yearToDate',
318	    ] as const;
319	  }
320	  if (mode === 'priorYearToDate') {
321	    return [
322	      monthUtils.getYearStart(monthUtils.prevYear(monthUtils.currentMonth())),
323	      monthUtils.prevYear(monthUtils.currentDate(), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
324	      'priorYearToDate',
325	    ] as const;
326	  }
327	  if (mode === 'currentQuarter') {
328	    const currentMonth = monthUtils.currentMonth();
329	    return [
330	      monthUtils.getQuarterStart(currentMonth),
331	      monthUtils.getQuarterEnd(currentMonth),
332	      'currentQuarter',
333	    ] as const;
334	  }
335	  if (mode === 'previousQuarter') {
336	    const prevQuarterMonth = monthUtils.prevQuarter(monthUtils.currentMonth());
337	    return [
338	      monthUtils.getQuarterStart(prevQuarterMonth),
339	      monthUtils.getQuarterEnd(prevQuarterMonth),
340	      'previousQuarter',
341	    ] as const;
342	  }
343	
344	  return [start, end, 'static'] as const;
345	}
346	
347	export function calculateSpendingReportTimeRange({
348	  compare,
349	  compareTo,
350	  isLive = true,
351	  mode = 'single-month',
352	}: {
353	  compare?: string;
354	  compareTo?: string;
355	  isLive?: boolean;
356	  mode?: 'budget' | 'average' | 'single-month';
357	}): [string, string] {
358	  if (['budget', 'average'].includes(mode) && isLive) {
359	    const month = compare ?? monthUtils.currentMonth();
360	    return [month, month];
361	  }
362	
363	  if (mode === 'single-month' && isLive && compare) {
364	    return [compare, compareTo ?? monthUtils.subMonths(compare, 1)];
365	  }
366	
367	  const [start, end] = calculateTimeRange(
368	    {
369	      start: compare,
370	      end: compareTo,
371	      mode: (isLive ?? true) ? 'sliding-window' : 'static',
372	    },
373	    {
374	      start: monthUtils.currentMonth(),
375	      end: monthUtils.subMonths(monthUtils.currentMonth(), 1),
376	      mode: 'sliding-window',
377	    },
378	  );
379	  return [start, end];
380	}
381
```

```text
import type { DashboardWidgetEntity } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { dashboardQueries } from '#reports';

type UseDashboardWidgetProps<W extends DashboardWidgetEntity> = Partial<
  Pick<W, 'id' | 'type'>
>;

export function useDashboardWidget<W extends DashboardWidgetEntity>({
  id,
  type,
}: UseDashboardWidgetProps<W>) {
  return useQuery({
    ...dashboardQueries.listDashboardWidgets<W>(),
    select: widgets => widgets.find(w => w.id === id && w.type === type),
    enabled: !!id && !!type,
  });
}
----
import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import type { RuleConditionEntity } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

export function useRuleConditionFilters<T extends RuleConditionEntity>(
  initialConditions: T[] = [],
  initialConditionsOp: 'and' | 'or' = 'and',
) {
  const [conditions, setConditions] = useState<T[]>(initialConditions);
  const [conditionsOp, setConditionsOp] = useState<'and' | 'or'>(
    initialConditionsOp,
  );
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<T[] | null>(null);

  const onApply = useCallback(
    (
      conditionsOrSavedFilter:
        | null
        | { conditions: T[]; conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or'; id: T[] | null }
        | T,
    ) => {
      if (conditionsOrSavedFilter === null) {
        setConditions([]);
        setSaved(null);
      } else if ('conditions' in conditionsOrSavedFilter) {
        setConditions([...conditionsOrSavedFilter.conditions]);
        setConditionsOp(conditionsOrSavedFilter.conditionsOp);
        setSaved(conditionsOrSavedFilter.id);
      } else {
        setConditions(state => [...state, conditionsOrSavedFilter]);
        setSaved(null);
      }
    },
    [setConditions],
  );

  const onUpdate = useCallback(
    (oldFilter: T, updatedFilter: T) => {
      setConditions(state =>
        state.map(f => (f === oldFilter ? updatedFilter : f)),
      );
      setSaved(null);
    },
    [setConditions],
  );

  const onDelete = useCallback(
    (deletedFilter: T) => {
      setConditions(state => state.filter(f => f !== deletedFilter));
      setSaved(null);
    },
    [setConditions],
  );

  return useMemo(
    () => ({
      conditions,
      saved,
      conditionsOp,
      onApply,
      onUpdate,
      onDelete,
      onConditionsOpChange: setConditionsOp,
    }),
    [
      conditions,
      saved,
      onApply,
      onUpdate,
      onDelete,
      setConditionsOp,
      conditionsOp,
    ],
  );
}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { Button } from '@actual-app/components/button';
import { SvgPencil1 } from '@actual-app/components/icons/v2';
import { InitialFocus } from '@actual-app/components/initial-focus';
import { Input } from '@actual-app/components/input';
import { theme } from '@actual-app/components/theme';
import { View } from '@actual-app/components/view';

type EditablePageHeaderTitleProps = {
  title: string;
  onSave: (newValue: string) => void;
};

export function EditablePageHeaderTitle({
  title: initialTitle,
  onSave,
}: EditablePageHeaderTitleProps) {
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(initialTitle);

  useEffect(() => setTitle(initialTitle), [initialTitle]);

  const onSaveValue = useCallback(
    (newValue: string) => {
      onSave(newValue);
      setTitle(newValue);
      setIsEditing(false);
    },
    [onSave],
  );

  if (isEditing) {
    return (
      <InitialFocus>
        <Input
          defaultValue={title}
          onEnter={onSaveValue}
          onUpdate={onSaveValue}
          onEscape={() => setIsEditing(false)}
          style={{
            fontSize: 'var(--font-size-25)',
            fontWeight: 500,
            marginTop: -3,
            marginBottom: -3,
            marginLeft: -6,
            paddingTop: 2,
            paddingBottom: 2,
            width: Math.max(20, title.length) + 'ch',
          }}
        />
      </InitialFocus>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: 'row',
        alignItems: 'center',
        gap: 3,
        '& .hover-visible': {
          opacity: 0,
          transition: 'opacity .25s',
        },
        '&:hover .hover-visible': {
          opacity: 1,
        },
      }}
    >
      {title}

      <Button
        variant="bare"
        className="hover-visible"
        onPress={() => setIsEditing(true)}
      >
        <SvgPencil1
          style={{
            width: 11,
            height: 11,
            color: theme.pageTextSubdued,
          }}
        />
      </Button>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```text
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { HotkeysProvider } from 'react-hotkeys-hook';
import { createMemoryRouter, RouterProvider } from 'react-router';
import type { InitialEntry } from 'react-router';

import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import { useEscapeToReportsOverview } from './useEscapeToReportsOverview';

function DrillDownReport({ children }: { children?: ReactNode }) {
  useEscapeToReportsOverview();
  return children;
}

function renderAt(initialEntries: InitialEntry[], reportChildren?: ReactNode) {
  const router = createMemoryRouter(
    [
      { path: '/reports', element: <div>Overview</div> },
      { path: '/reports/:dashboardId', element: <div>Dashboard</div> },
      {
        path: '/reports/net-worth',
        element: <DrillDownReport>{reportChildren}</DrillDownReport>,
      },
    ],
    { initialEntries, initialIndex: initialEntries.length - 1 },
  );

  render(
    <HotkeysProvider initiallyActiveScopes={['app']}>
      <RouterProvider router={router} />
    </HotkeysProvider>,
  );

  return () => router.state.location.pathname;
}

describe('useEscapeToReportsOverview', () => {
  it('returns to the dashboard the report was opened from', async () => {
    const currentPath = renderAt([
      '/reports/my-dashboard',
      { pathname: '/reports/net-worth', state: { goBack: true } },
    ]);

    await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');

    expect(currentPath()).toBe('/reports/my-dashboard');
  });

  it('goes to the reports overview when the report was opened directly', async () => {
    const currentPath = renderAt(['/reports/net-worth']);

    await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');

    expect(currentPath()).toBe('/reports');
  });

  it('does nothing while a popover is open', async () => {
    const currentPath = renderAt(
      ['/reports/net-worth'],
      <div data-popover>Menu</div>,
    );

    await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');

    expect(currentPath()).toBe('/reports/net-worth');
  });

  it('does nothing while a modal is open', async () => {
    const currentPath = renderAt(
      ['/reports/net-worth'],
      // Mirrors the markup react-aria's Dialog renders inside our Modal
      // oxlint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/prefer-tag-over-role
      <div role="dialog">Modal</div>,
    );

    await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');

    expect(currentPath()).toBe('/reports/net-worth');
```

```text
import React from 'react';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Provider } from 'react-redux';

import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';

import { configureAppStore } from './redux/store';
import type { AppStore } from './redux/store';

export function createTestQueryClient() {
  return new QueryClient({
    defaultOptions: {
      queries: {
        retry: false,
      },
    },
  });
}

export function configureTestAppStore(
  ...args: Parameters<typeof configureAppStore>
) {
  return configureAppStore(...args);
}

let testQueryClient = createTestQueryClient();
let testStore = configureTestAppStore({
  queryClient: testQueryClient,
});

export function resetTestProviders() {
  testQueryClient = createTestQueryClient();
  testStore = configureTestAppStore({ queryClient: testQueryClient });
}

export function createTestAppStore() {
  return configureAppStore({
    queryClient: testQueryClient,
  });
}

export function TestProviders({
  children,
  queryClient,
  store,
}: {
  queryClient?: QueryClient;
  store?: AppStore;
  children: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient ?? testQueryClient}>
      <Provider store={store ?? testStore}>{children}</Provider>
    </QueryClientProvider>
  );
}
```

```text
// Minimal connection mock used by desktop-client component tests.
//
// This mirrors `@actual-app/core`'s test-only mock implementation so that
// `useSpreadsheet()` and other code paths can call `send()` and receive a
// promise with a stable shape.

type Listener = (args: unknown) => void;
type Handler = (args: unknown) => unknown | Promise<unknown>;

let listeners = new Map<string, Array<Listener>>();
let serverHandler:
  | null
  | ((msg: { name: string; args: unknown; catchErrors: boolean }) => unknown) =
  null;

export const initServer = (handlers: Record<string, Handler>) => {
  serverHandler = msg => {
    const { name, args, catchErrors } = msg;
    if (handlers[name]) {
      return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
        const promise = Promise.resolve(handlers[name](args));

        if (catchErrors) {
          return promise.then(
            data => ({ data }),
            error => ({ error }),
          );
        }

        return promise;
      });
    }
  };
};

export const clearServer = async () => {
  serverHandler = null;
  listeners = new Map();
};

export const serverPush = (name: string, args: unknown) => {
  void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
    const listens = listeners.get(name);
    if (listens) {
      listens.forEach(listener => {
        listener(args);
      });
    }
  });
};

export const send = async (
  name: string,
  args: unknown,
  { catchErrors = false } = {},
) => {
  if (serverHandler) {
    return serverHandler({ name, args, catchErrors });
  } else {
    throw new Error('`send` called with no mock server installed');
  }
};

export const sendCatch = (name: string, args: unknown) => {
  return send(name, args, { catchErrors: true });
};

export const listen = (name: string, cb: Listener) => {
  if (!listeners.get(name)) {
    listeners.set(name, []);
  }

  listeners.get(name)!.push(cb);

  return () => {
    const arr = listeners.get(name) ?? [];
    listeners.set(
      name,
      arr.filter(cb_ => cb_ !== cb),
    );
```

**Relative date ranges: Net Worth, Cash Flow, Summary and others save absolute start/end dates even for a sliding window like 'last 6 months', and move them forward when the page loads. How should the check compare date ranges?**

Options:
- **Compare the range setting (Recommended)** - For relative modes (sliding-window, lastMonth, yearToDate, Spending's 'live' ranges, etc.) compare the mode and the window length, not the resolved dates. For a fixed ('static') range, compare the exact dates. A widget saved as 'last 6 months' never shows as modified just because time has passed. Applies to all eight reports, not just Spending/Calendar.
- **Compare resolved dates** - Simpler, but a widget saved last month as a sliding window would show '(modified)' as soon as it's opened.

**Should the Save widget button be disabled when nothing has changed?**

Options:
- **Leave it enabled (Recommended)** - As the issue proposes. Keeps the change small; the label is the only new UI.
- **Disable when unmodified** - Clearer signal, but changes existing behaviour and touches tests.

**Where should '(modified)' appear on narrow (mobile) screens, which use MobilePageHeader instead of the editable title?**

Options:
- **Desktop and mobile (Recommended)** - Show it in both headers. Mobile still shows the Save widget button inside the report Header, so users can lose changes there too.
- **Desktop only** - Only next to the EditablePageHeaderTitle, mirroring where Custom Reports show it.


**Answer:** Compare the range setting (Recommended), Leave it enabled (Recommended), Desktop and mobile (Recommended)
</details></tool-use>

I've surveyed all 7 pages plus the type file, the shared hooks and the tests. All paths are under `c:\Actual Budget\packages\desktop-client\src\` unless they're absolute.

## Facts that apply to every page

**The save mutation.** `useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation` is in `reports\mutations.ts:249-270`. It already has its own handlers, so each page's per-call handlers come on top of these:
```ts
mutationFn: async ({ widget }) => await sendThrow('dashboard-update-widget', widget),
onSuccess: () => invalidateDashboardQueries(queryClient),
onError: error => { console.error(...); dispatchErrorNotification(dispatch, t('There was an error updating the dashboard widget. Please try again.'), error) },
```
After a successful save the dashboard query is invalidated and refetched, so `widget` comes back as a new object. Pages whose effects depend on `widget?.meta?.timeFrame` will re-run `calculateTimeRange`.

**Loading the widget.** `hooks\useDashboardWidget.ts` uses `useQuery` with `select: widgets => widgets.find(w => w.id === id && w.type === type)` and `enabled: !!id && !!type`.
- If the id is missing or doesn't match a widget, `widget` is `undefined`.
- TanStack v5 (`^5.101.2`) matters here. A disabled query with no data stays `isPending === true` forever, while `isLoading` is `false`.
- GoalReport, AgeOfMoney and NetWorth gate on `isLoading`, so they render fine with no widget.
- CashFlow, Spending, Summary, Crossover and Calendar gate on `isPending`. On the id-less routes (`/reports/cash-flow`, etc., defined in `ReportRouter.tsx`) they will most likely show `<LoadingIndicator />` forever. I haven't run this; it's what the v5 semantics imply. If the id is present but doesn't match a widget, they do render with `widget` undefined.

**Filters.** `hooks\useRuleConditionFilters.ts` initialises synchronously: `useState<T[]>(initialConditions)` (default `[]`) and `useState(initialConditionsOp)` (default `'and'`). It never re-syncs when the widget prop changes. So `conditions` and `conditionsOp` match the saved meta on the first render, except that `undefined` becomes `[]` and `'and'`.

**Time ranges.** `calculateTimeRange` (`components\reports\reportRanges.ts:250-345`) does **not** return the saved values unchanged for relative modes:
- `'full'`: `[savedStart, max(latestTxMonth, currentMonth), 'full']`. The end is recomputed.
- `'sliding-window'`: if both dates are day-shaped (`YYYY-MM-DD`), it keeps the same day width ending today. If month-shaped, it calls `getLatestRange(offset)`, i.e. `[currentMonth - offset, currentMonth]`.
- `'lastMonth' | 'lastYear' | 'yearToDate' | 'priorYearToDate' | 'currentQuarter' | 'previousQuarter'`: computed from today.
- `'static'` (and anything else): `[start, end, 'static']` as saved.

So for relative modes, `start`/`end` state won't equal the saved `meta.timeFrame.start/end` even after the effect runs. Only `mode` matches.

**The shared `Header`** (`components\reports\Header.tsx:129-145`) has the Live/Static toggle:
```ts
const newMode = mode === 'static' ? 'sliding-window' : 'static';
const [newStart, newEnd] = calculateTimeRange({ start, end, mode: newMode });
onChangeDates(newStart, newEnd, newMode);
```
- The `DateRangePicker` always calls `onChangeDates(newStart, newEnd, 'static')` (line 181).
- Presets come from `buildDateRangePresets` and pass a full `[start, end, mode]` tuple (line 105). That's where `lastMonth`/`yearToDate`/etc. come from; I didn't read that file's body.
- Page buttons passed as `children` render on the right (lines 196-207).

**`EditablePageHeaderTitle`** (`components\EditablePageHeaderTitle.tsx`):
- Shows the title plus a bare pencil `Button`.
- Clicking the pencil swaps in an `<Input defaultValue={title} onEnter={onSaveValue} onUpdate={onSaveValue} onEscape=...>`.
- `onSaveValue` calls `onSave(newValue)`, then sets local title and `isEditing=false`. It also re-syncs from props via `useEffect(() => setTitle(initialTitle), [initialTitle])`.
- On every page except Summary, `onSaveWidgetName` spreads the **saved** `widget.meta`, so renaming never persists unsaved edits.

- The initial `useState` values are placeholders:
  - `start` and `end` are `''` (100-101), and `mode` is `'static'` (102).
  - `selectedExpenseCategories` is `expenseCategories` (from the categories at render time, possibly empty) and `selectedIncomeAccountIds` is `accounts.map(a=>a.id)`.
  - `swr` is `0.04`, `useCustomGrowth` is `false`, `estimatedReturn` and `expectedContribution` are `null`, `projectionType` is `'hampel'`, `expenseAdjustmentFactor` is `1.0` and `showHiddenCategories` is `false` (112-122).
- `selectionsInitialized` (123) is reset to `false` whenever `widget?.id` changes (126-128).
- The one-time init effect (131-172) waits until `!isCategoriesLoading`, then:
  - sets the expense categories from `meta.expenseCategoryIds`, filtered from `categories.list`, or all non-income categories
  - sets income accounts from `meta.incomeAccountIds`, or all accounts
  - sets `swr` from `meta.safeWithdrawalRate ?? 0.04`
  - sets `useCustomGrowth = estimatedReturn != null || expectedContribution != null`
  - sets `estimatedReturn` and `expectedContribution` (default `null`), `projectionType ?? 'hampel'`, `expenseAdjustmentFactor ?? 1.0` and `showHiddenCategories ?? false`
  - sets `selectionsInitialized = true`
  - Its dependencies include `widget?.meta`, but the `selectionsInitialized` guard stops it re-running after a save refetch.
- The async effect (174-202) gets only the earliest transaction. `latestTransaction` is **forced** to `lastDayOfMonth(previousMonth)`, which excludes the current month. It also sets `allMonths`.
- The date effect (204-241) runs when `latestTransaction && allMonths?.length`:
  - It calls `calculateTimeRange(meta.timeFrame, defaultTimeFrame, latestTransaction)`.
  - The default is defined at 52-56: `{start: currentMonth-120, end: currentMonth-1, mode:'full'}`.
  - It then **adjusts further**:
    - `'sliding-window'`: shifts both bounds back 1 month and clamps them.
    - `'full'`: uses `[earliestMonth, latestMonth]` from `allMonths`.
    - Otherwise: clamps.
  - If `end < start`, it sets `end = start`.
- `onChangeDates` (243-274) applies the same shift and clamp to user changes.
- Because of this, saved `timeFrame.start/end` almost never equal state for sliding or full modes. Note too that a saved sliding window gets shifted back one more month every time it's loaded.
- The page renders `<LoadingIndicator />` until `allMonths && displayData && start && end && !isCategoriesLoading` (426-428).
- Saving stores the expense category ids as **all** selected categories, including hidden ones (`selectedExpenseCategories`). The report itself filters hidden ones out via `expenseCategoryIds` (327-333).

**Name editor:** yes, at 400-424. `title = widget?.meta?.name || t('Crossover Point')`. It saves `{...meta, name}`, and with no widget it shows an error notification.

**Rendering**
- `PageHeader`/`EditablePageHeaderTitle` at 441-452.
- `<Header start end mode allMonths earliestTransaction latestTransaction onChangeDates>` (457-471) gets no filters.
- "Save widget" is `{widget && ...}` at 466-470.
- The settings sidebar (481-1035) is hidden on narrow widths.

**Relative ranges:** `timeFrame.mode`, defaulting to `'full'`, with the one-month-back shift described above.

## 5. AgeOfMoney.tsx (`components\reports\reports\AgeOfMoney.tsx`)

**onSaveWidget (185-225)** is a `useCallback` that uses **`mutateAsync`**, not `mutate` with `onSuccess`:
```ts
await updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutateAsync({
  widget: { id: widget.id, meta: {
    ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
    granularity,
  } },
});
dispatch(addNotification({ notification: { type: 'message', message: t('Dashboard widget successfully saved.') } }));
```
- There's no try/catch. On failure the promise rejects after the hook's own `onError` notification fires, and the success notification is skipped.
- It throws if there's no widget.

**Initialisation**
- `conditions`/`conditionsOp` come from `useRuleConditionFilters` (81-84). Synchronous.
- `start` and `end` are `useState(currentMonth())` and `mode` is `useState('sliding-window')` (91-93). Not from meta.
- `granularity` is `useState(widget?.meta?.granularity ?? 'monthly')` (94-96). Synchronous.
- The async effect (117-158) sets `earliestTransaction`, `latestTransaction` and `allMonths`.
- The effect at 160-171 runs when `latestTransaction` is set: `calculateTimeRange(widget?.meta?.timeFrame, undefined, latestTransaction)`, then sets `start`/`end`/`mode`.
  - Because there's no default time frame, the fallback is `[currentMonth-5, currentMonth, 'sliding-window']`.
- The page renders `<LoadingIndicator />` until `allMonths && data` (251-253).

**Name editor:** yes, at 230-249. `title = widget?.meta?.name || t('Age of Money')`. It uses `mutateAsync` to save `{...meta, name}` and throws if there's no widget.

**Rendering**
- `PageHeader`/`EditablePageHeaderTitle` at 266-277.
- `<Header ... granularities={['month','day']} filters ... inlineContent={<GranularitySelector/>}>` (282-310).
- "Save widget" is `{widget && ...}` at 305-309.
- `GranularitySelector` (407-459) is a button labelled `aria-label={t('Change granularity')}` with a Popover/Menu offering daily, weekly and monthly.
- `widget` can be undefined and renders correctly, since the page uses `isLoading`.

**Relative ranges:** `timeFrame.mode`. With no saved timeFrame, the range defaults to a 6-month sliding window.

## 6. Calendar.tsx (`components\reports\reports\Calendar.tsx`)

**onSaveWidget (354-399)**
```ts
meta: {
  ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
  conditions,
  conditionsOp,
  timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
},
```
- Uses `.mutate(..., { onSuccess, onError })`. This is the **only** page with a per-call `onError` (386-396):
  ```ts
  onError: error => { dispatch(addNotification({ notification: { type: 'error', message: t('Failed to save dashboard widget.') } })); console.error('Error saving widget:', error); }
  ```
  Combined with the hook's own `onError`, a failure produces two error notifications.
- It throws if there's no widget.

**Initialisation**
- `start` is `useState(dayFromDate(currentMonth()))`, `end` is `useState(currentDay())` and `mode` is `useState('full')` (101-105).
- `conditions`/`conditionsOp` come from `useRuleConditionFilters` (127-137).
- **URL search-param effect** (139-175). If `?day=` or `?month=` is present, it calls `onApplyFilter({conditions: [...meta.conditions, {field:'date', op:'is', value: day|month, (options:{month:true})}], conditionsOp: 'and', id: []})`.
  - This changes `conditions` and forces `conditionsOp` to `'and'` after mount. In that case state differs from meta and has a date condition appended, which would then be saved.
- The async effect (254-304) sets `earliestTransaction`, `latestTransaction` and `allMonths`.
  - The `earliestTransaction` state is declared late, at line 522.
- The effect at 306-321 runs when `latestTransaction` is set: `calculateTimeRange(meta.timeFrame, {dayFromDate(currentMonth), currentDay, 'full'}, latestTransaction)`.
- Odd detail: the `params` memo (177-189) calls `setDirty(false)` during render.
- The page does not return early; it always renders the Page.

**Name editor:** yes, at 331-346. `title = widget?.meta?.name || t('Calendar')`. It saves `{...meta, name}` and throws if there's no widget.

**Rendering**
- `PageHeader`/`EditablePageHeaderTitle` at 535-547.
- `<Header ... filters={conditions} onApply ...>` starts at 552.
- "Save widget" is `{widget && ...}` at 569-572.
- `Calendar()` reads `useSearchParams()` (78) and passes `parameters` to the inner component, so tests need a router.

**Relative ranges:** `timeFrame.mode`, defaulting to `'full'`.

## 7. GoalReport.tsx (`components\reports\reports\GoalReport.tsx`)

**onSaveWidget (194-240)** is a plain function, not async.
- With no widget, it calls `notifyMissingWidget()`, an error notification with `t('Cannot save: No widget available.')` (165-174), and returns.
- **Validation:** if `!isValidGoalTarget(targetAmount)`, it shows the error `t('Goal amount must be greater than zero.')` and returns without saving.
- The meta it writes:
  ```ts
  const { linkedTag: _previousTag, ...previousMeta } = widget.meta ?? {};
  meta: {
    ...previousMeta,
    ...(linkedTag ? { linkedTag } : {}),
    conditions,
    targetAmount,
    conditionsOp,
    timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
  },
  ```
  So `linkedTag` is **removed** from meta when it's cleared.
- Uses `.mutate(..., { onSuccess })` with the success notification. No per-call `onError`.

**Initialisation**
- `start` is `useState(dayFromDate(currentMonth()))`, `end` is `useState(currentDay())` and `mode` is `useState('full')` (69-73).
- `targetAmount` is `useState(widget?.meta?.targetAmount ?? 0)` (74-76). Synchronous.
- `linkedTag` is `useState(widget?.meta?.linkedTag)` (77). Synchronous.
- `conditions`/`conditionsOp` come from `useRuleConditionFilters` (87-97). Synchronous.
- The async effect (100-133) sets earliest, latest and `allMonths`, with at least 12 months back.
- The effect at 135-150 runs when `latestTransaction` is set: `calculateTimeRange(meta.timeFrame, {dayFromDate(currentMonth), currentDay, 'full'}, latestTransaction)`.
- There's no early return.

**Name editor (item 3):** there is no separate inline editor in GoalReport. The only name editing is the same `EditablePageHeaderTitle` in `PageHeader` (263-274). `onSaveWidgetName` (176-192) saves only `{...(widget.meta ?? {}), name}`, using `newName || t('Personal goal')`. With no widget it calls `notifyMissingWidget()`.
- Nothing else saves immediately. The "Goal amount" `AmountInput` (355-361, `onUpdate={setTargetAmount}`) and the "Linked tag" `GoalTagSelect` (374-379, `onChange={setLinkedTag}`) only update local state. They persist only through "Save widget".
- The *card* (`GoalCard.tsx`) is different. It has context-menu "rename" and "set-goal" actions that save immediately through `onMetaChange`; see the GoalCard tests below.

**Rendering**
- `PageHeader` is at 263-274.
- "Save widget" is `{widget && ...}` inside `<Header ... show1Month>` at 296-300.
- `widget` can be undefined and renders correctly (`isLoading`). It's tested on `/reports/goal`.

**Relative ranges:** `timeFrame.mode`, defaulting to `'full'`.

## Widget meta types (`c:\Actual Budget\packages\loot-core\src\types\models\dashboard.ts`)

`TimeFrame` (11-24) is `{ start: string; end: string; mode: 'sliding-window' | 'static' | 'full' | 'lastMonth' | 'lastYear' | 'yearToDate' | 'priorYearToDate' | 'currentQuarter' | 'previousQuarter' }`. Each meta type below is `{...} | null`.

| Type (line) | `type` string | meta fields |
|---|---|---|
| `NetWorthWidget` (41) | `'net-worth-card'` | `name?, conditions?, conditionsOp?: 'and'\|'or', timeFrame?, interval?: 'Daily'\|'Weekly'\|'Monthly'\|'Yearly', mode?: 'trend'\|'stacked'` |
| `CashFlowWidget` (53) | `'cash-flow-card'` | `name?, conditions?, conditionsOp?, timeFrame?, showBalance?: boolean` |
| `SpendingWidget` (76) | `'spending-card'` | `name?, conditions?, conditionsOp?, compare?: string, compareTo?: string, isLive?: boolean, mode?: 'single-month'\|'budget'\|'average', averageRange?: SpendingAverageRange` (64-74) |
| `GoalCardWidget` (90) | `'goal-card'` | `name?, targetAmount?: number (cents), linkedTag?: string (no '#'), conditions?, conditionsOp?, timeFrame?` |
| `CrossoverWidget` (119) | `'crossover-card'` | `name?, expenseCategoryIds?: string[], incomeAccountIds?: string[], timeFrame?, safeWithdrawalRate?: number, estimatedReturn?: number\|null, expectedContribution?: number\|null, projectionType?: 'hampel'\|'median'\|'mean', showHiddenCategories?: boolean, expenseAdjustmentFactor?: number` |
| `AgeOfMoneyWidget` (335) | `'age-of-money-card'` | `name?, conditions?, conditionsOp?, timeFrame?, granularity?: 'daily'\|'weekly'\|'monthly'` |
| `SummaryWidget` (396) | `'summary-card'` | `name?, conditions?, conditionsOp?, timeFrame?, content?: string` (a JSON string of `SummaryContent` (407-420): `{type:'sum'\|'avgPerMonth'\|'avgPerYear'\|'avgPerTransact', fontSize?}` or `{type:'percentage', divisorConditions, divisorConditionsOp, divisorAllTimeDateRange?, fontSize?}`) |
| `CalendarWidget` (422) | `'calendar-card'` | `name?, conditions?, conditionsOp?, timeFrame?` |

`AbstractWidget` (26-39) is `{ id, dashboard_page_id, type, x, y, width, height, meta, tombstone }`.

Lifecycle and assertions:
- `beforeEach` runs `vi.clearAllMocks()`, mocks `useNavigate`, sets `useReport` to `null` and sets `useResponsive` to `{isNarrowWidth:false}`. `afterEach` runs `await clearServer()`.
- The tests wait with `screen.findByText('Matching transactions')`, then `waitFor` until the header range shows the saved time frame.
- To check a save, they click `getByRole('button', {name:'Save widget'})`, then `await waitFor(() => expect(updateWidget).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ id: WIDGET_ID, meta: {...} }))`.

- Mobile: set `useResponsive` to `{isNarrowWidth:true}` and click `getByRole('button',{name:'Back'})`, expecting `mockNavigate` to be called with `'/reports'`.

**`GoalCard.test.tsx`**:
- It renders `<GoalCard widgetId isEditing meta onMetaChange>` directly inside `TestProviders`, with no router.
- The tags cache is pre-seeded with `queryClient.setQueryData(tagQueries.list().queryKey, TAGS)`.
- It mocks `#hooks/useIsInViewport` to `() => true` because jsdom has no IntersectionObserver. It also mocks the connection, `useNavigate`, `summarySpreadsheet` and `useReport`.
- `initServer({ 'get-latest-transaction': () => null })` runs in `beforeEach`.
- Live updates are tested with `act(async () => serverPush('sync-event', { type: 'applied', tables }))`.
- Context-menu actions are triggered through `fireEvent.contextMenu(heading)`, then by finding the item in `store.getState().contextMenu.items` and calling `act(() => item.onClick())` (543-557).
- Card renames and set-goal assert directly on `onMetaChange` (not a server call).

**`useEscapeToReportsOverview.test.tsx`** uses `createMemoryRouter` with `RouterProvider` inside a `HotkeysProvider initiallyActiveScopes={['app']}`. It's useful if a page's behaviour depends on hotkeys.

**What new tests for the other pages will need, based on the code above**
- **Header-based pages** (CashFlow, Summary, AgeOfMoney, Calendar, Crossover): the same `Header` stub works.
  - Summary passes no `onApply`, so the "Add filter" stub button would crash. Guard it or omit it.
  - Crossover passes no filters either.
- **Spending** doesn't use `Header`. You'd interact with its own toolbar: the Live/Static button, `Select`s, `ModeButton`s and the "Save" button (not "Save widget").
- **Data gating:**
  - CashFlow returns `null` until `useReport` returns non-null `data`, then destructures `graphData, totalExpenses, totalIncome, totalTransfers`. The mocked `useReport` must return that shape, and `CashFlowGraph` probably needs stubbing.
  - AgeOfMoney renders `LoadingIndicator` until `data` exists, and needs `currentAge`, `trend`, `graphData` and `insufficientData`.
  - Spending needs `data.intervalData[27]` and `averageRange`.
  - Crossover needs `useAccounts`/`useCategories` data and `displayData.graphData`.
  - Calendar also uses `useTransactions`, `usePayees`, `useAccounts`, `useCategories`, `useSearchParams`, `react-spring` and `@use-gesture`. It's the heaviest to render.
- **Missing widget:** for the five `isPending` pages, an id-less route will probably hang on the loading indicator. To test "no widget", use a non-matching id, or change those pages to `isLoading`.

**Calendar: when you click a day on the Calendar dashboard card, the report opens with ?day=… and adds a date filter to the current filters. Save widget would then write that filter into the widget. Should that drill-in filter show '(modified)'?**

Options:
- **Yes, show (modified) (Recommended)** - Accurate: pressing Save widget would permanently add that date filter. The label warns the user before they bake it in. No special-casing.
- **No, ignore drill-in filter** - Treat the URL-added date condition as a temporary view and exclude it from the comparison. But Save widget would still save it, which breaks the rule that compared settings = saved settings.

**Summary: unlike the other reports, renaming a Summary widget also saves the current (possibly unsaved) 'Show as' content. With the label, a rename would silently clear '(modified)' for content changes. What should happen?**

Options:
- **Rename saves only the name (Recommended)** - Make Summary's rename spread the saved meta and write just `name`, like the other seven reports. Unsaved content changes stay unsaved and the label stays.
- **Keep current behaviour** - Leave the rename as is; the label correctly reflects that content was saved by the rename. Inconsistent with the other reports.


**Answer:** Yes, show (modified) (Recommended), Rename saves only the name (Recommended)
</details></tool-use>

````markdown
# Plan: "(modified)" label for eight report widgets (#125)

## Context

Custom Reports show "(modified)" next to the report name when there are unsaved edits ([SaveReport.tsx:269-273](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/SaveReport.tsx#L269-L273)). The other widget reports silently drop unsaved edits when the user leaves. Epic #96 chose to **show** unsaved state rather than block navigation (no App.tsx/router change). This sub-issue adds a shared change-detection helper + label and wires it into Net Worth, Cash Flow, Spending, Summary, Crossover, Age of Money, Calendar and Goal.

## Design decisions (confirmed with user)

1. **Compare the range *setting*, not resolved dates.** Applies to all eight reports, not only Spending/Calendar: Net Worth, Cash Flow, etc. save absolute `start/end` even for `sliding-window`, and `calculateTimeRange` ([reportRanges.ts:250](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reportRanges.ts#L250)) re-resolves them on load. Normalisation:
   - `static` → `{mode, start, end}`
   - `sliding-window` → `{mode, shape: 'day'|'month', width}` (width = calendar-day or calendar-month difference). This also absorbs Crossover's extra "shift back one month" on load.
   - `full` → `{mode}`. End is always recomputed; Crossover also replaces the start with the earliest month.
   - `lastMonth`, `lastYear`, `yearToDate`, `priorYearToDate`, `currentQuarter`, `previousQuarter` → `{mode}`

So a successful save refetches and clears the label, and a failed save leaves it. Both match the acceptance criteria with no extra code. Renames spread the *saved* meta, so a rename never clears or sets the label for settings (Goal acceptance criterion).
7. **"Exactly the settings Save writes" is guaranteed by construction.** Each report has one pure `build…WidgetSettings(state)` function. `onSaveWidget` writes `{...widget.meta, ...build(state)}`, and the comparison uses `toComparable(build(state))` vs `toComparable(widget.meta)`. `toComparable` reads only the keys `build` returns.
````

````text
Custom Reports show "(modified)" next to the report name when there are unsaved edits ([SaveReport.tsx:269-273](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/SaveReport.tsx#L269-L273)). The other widget reports silently drop unsaved edits when the user leaves. Epic #96 chose to **show** unsaved state rather than block navigation (no App.tsx/router change). import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
````
```text
import type { SpendingAverageRange } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

export type SpendingAverageRangeKey =
  | 'last-3-months'
  | 'last-6-months'
  | 'last-12-months'
  | 'year-to-date'
  | 'all-time';

export const DEFAULT_SPENDING_AVERAGE_RANGE: SpendingAverageRange = {
  mode: 'last-n-months',
  months: 3,
};

const supportedLastNMonths = [3, 6, 12] as const;

function isSupportedLastNMonths(
  months: number,
): months is (typeof supportedLastNMonths)[number] {
  return supportedLastNMonths.some(supported => supported === months);
}

export function normalizeSpendingAverageRange(
  averageRange?: SpendingAverageRange,
): SpendingAverageRange {
  if (!averageRange) {
    return DEFAULT_SPENDING_AVERAGE_RANGE;
  }

  if (
    averageRange.mode === 'last-n-months' &&
    !isSupportedLastNMonths(averageRange.months)
  ) {
    return DEFAULT_SPENDING_AVERAGE_RANGE;
  }

  return averageRange;
}
```

```typescript
import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type {
  RuleConditionEntity,
  TimeFrame,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import { isEqual } from 'es-toolkit';

/**
 * A time frame reduced to the setting the user chose, not the dates it
 * currently resolves to. Relative ranges (for example a sliding window or
 * "year to date") are re-resolved every time a report opens, so comparing
 * their dates would flag a widget as modified just because time has passed.
 */
export type ComparableTimeFrame =
  | { mode: 'static'; start: string; end: string }
  | { mode: 'sliding-window'; shape: 'day' | 'month'; width: number }
  | { mode: Exclude<TimeFrame['mode'], 'static' | 'sliding-window'> };

export function toComparableTimeFrame(
  timeFrame?: Partial<TimeFrame> | null,
  defaultTimeFrame?: Partial<TimeFrame>,
): ComparableTimeFrame {
  // Mirrors the fallbacks in `calculateTimeRange` so a widget without a
  // saved time frame compares equal to the range the report opens with.
  const start =
    timeFrame?.start ??
    defaultTimeFrame?.start ??
    monthUtils.subMonths(monthUtils.currentMonth(), 5);
  const end =
    timeFrame?.end ?? defaultTimeFrame?.end ?? monthUtils.currentMonth();
  const mode = timeFrame?.mode ?? defaultTimeFrame?.mode ?? 'sliding-window';

  if (mode === 'static') {
    return { mode, start, end };
  }

  if (mode === 'sliding-window') {
    if (
      monthUtils.isValidYearMonthDay(start) &&
      monthUtils.isValidYearMonthDay(end)
    ) {
      return {
        mode,
        shape: 'day',
        width: Math.max(monthUtils.differenceInCalendarDays(end, start), 0),
      };
    }
    return {
      mode,
      shape: 'month',
      width: monthUtils.differenceInCalendarMonths(end, start),
    };
  }

  return { mode };
}

export type ComparableConditions = {
  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[];
  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or';
};

export function toComparableConditions(
  conditions?: RuleConditionEntity[] | null,
  conditionsOp?: 'and' | 'or' | null,
): ComparableConditions {
  // Same defaults as `useRuleConditionFilters`.
  return {
    conditions: conditions ?? [],
    conditionsOp: conditionsOp ?? 'and',
  };
}

// Drops keys whose value is `undefined`, the same way saving the widget
// does, so `{ a: undefined }` and `{}` compare equal.
function toSavedShape(value: unknown): unknown {
  return value === undefined ? undefined : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value));
}

type IsWidgetModifiedArgs<T> = {
  /** False when the report was opened without a widget. */
  hasWidget: boolean;
  /** False until the report has finished loading its saved settings. */
  isReady: boolean;
  /** The saved widget settings, in comparable form. */
  saved: T;
  /** The settings "Save widget" would write now, in comparable form. */
  current: T;
};

export function isWidgetModified<T>({
  hasWidget,
  isReady,
  saved,
  current,
}: IsWidgetModifiedArgs<T>): boolean {
  if (!hasWidget || !isReady) {
    return false;
  }
  return !isEqual(toSavedShape(saved), toSavedShape(current));
}
```

```typescript
import type {
  NetWorthWidget,
  RuleConditionEntity,
  TimeFrame,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import {
  toComparableConditions,
  toComparableTimeFrame,
} from '#components/reports/widgetModified';

type NetWorthMeta = NonNullable<NetWorthWidget['meta']>;
type NetWorthInterval = NonNullable<NetWorthMeta['interval']>;
type NetWorthGraphMode = NonNullable<NetWorthMeta['mode']>;

export type NetWorthWidgetSettings = Required<
  Pick<
    NetWorthMeta,
    'conditions' | 'conditionsOp' | 'interval' | 'mode' | 'timeFrame'
  >
>;

export function getDefaultNetWorthInterval(
  mode: TimeFrame['mode'],
): NetWorthInterval {
  // A single month reads better week by week than as one monthly point.
  return mode === 'lastMonth' ? 'Weekly' : 'Monthly';
}

/** The settings "Save widget" writes for a Net Worth widget. */
export function buildNetWorthWidgetSettings({
  conditions,
  conditionsOp,
  interval,
  graphMode,
  start,
  end,
  mode,
}: {
  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[];
  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or';
  interval: NetWorthInterval;
  graphMode: NetWorthGraphMode;
  start: string;
  end: string;
  mode: TimeFrame['mode'];
}): NetWorthWidgetSettings {
  return {
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    interval,
    mode: graphMode,
    timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
  };
}

export function toComparableNetWorthSettings(
  meta: Partial<NetWorthMeta> | null | undefined,
) {
  const timeFrame = toComparableTimeFrame(meta?.timeFrame);
  return {
    ...toComparableConditions(meta?.conditions, meta?.conditionsOp),
    interval: meta?.interval ?? getDefaultNetWorthInterval(timeFrame.mode),
    mode: meta?.mode ?? 'trend',
    timeFrame,
  };
}
```

```typescript
import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type {
  CashFlowWidget,
  RuleConditionEntity,
  TimeFrame,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import {
  toComparableConditions,
  toComparableTimeFrame,
} from '#components/reports/widgetModified';

type CashFlowMeta = NonNullable<CashFlowWidget['meta']>;

// Month-shaped so the range means the whole current month (the query clamps
// to today); day-shaped values here would slide by days instead.
export const defaultTimeFrame = {
  start: monthUtils.currentMonth(),
  end: monthUtils.currentMonth(),
  mode: 'sliding-window',
} satisfies TimeFrame;

export type CashFlowWidgetSettings = Required<
  Pick<CashFlowMeta, 'conditions' | 'conditionsOp' | 'timeFrame' | 'showBalance'>
>;

/** The settings "Save widget" writes for a Cash Flow widget. */
export function buildCashFlowWidgetSettings({
  conditions,
  conditionsOp,
  start,
  end,
  mode,
  showBalance,
}: {
  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[];
  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or';
  start: string;
  end: string;
  mode: TimeFrame['mode'];
  showBalance: boolean;
}): CashFlowWidgetSettings {
  return {
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
    showBalance,
  };
}

export function toComparableCashFlowSettings(
  meta: Partial<CashFlowMeta> | null | undefined,
) {
  return {
    ...toComparableConditions(meta?.conditions, meta?.conditionsOp),
    timeFrame: toComparableTimeFrame(meta?.timeFrame, defaultTimeFrame),
    showBalance: meta?.showBalance ?? true,
  };
}
```

```typescript
}: {

  };
}
```

```text
import { CalendarGraph } from '#components/reports/graphs/CalendarGraph';

import { calculateTimeRange } from '#components/reports/reportRanges';

const CHEVRON_HEIGHT = 42;

export function Calendar() {
  const params = useParams();
  const [searchParams] = useSearchParams();
  const { data: widget, isPending } = useDashboardWidget<CalendarWidget>({
    id: params.id,
    type: 'calendar-card',
  });

  if (isPending) {
    return <LoadingIndicator />;
  }

  return <CalendarInner widget={widget} parameters={searchParams} />;
}

type CalendarInnerProps = {
  widget?: CalendarWidget;
  parameters: URLSearchParams;
};

function CalendarInner({ widget, parameters }: CalendarInnerProps) {
  const locale = useLocale();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const format = useFormat();

  const [start, setStart] = useState(
    monthUtils.dayFromDate(monthUtils.currentMonth()),
  );
  const [end, setEnd] = useState(monthUtils.currentDay());

  const [query, setQuery] = useState<Query | undefined>(undefined);

  const [latestTransaction, setLatestTransaction] = useState('');

  const {
  const [_firstDayOfWeekIdx] = useSyncedPref('firstDayOfWeekIdx');
  const firstDayOfWeekIdx = _firstDayOfWeekIdx || '0';
  const {
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    onApply: onApplyFilter,
    onDelete: onDeleteFilter,
    onUpdate: onUpdateFilter,
    onConditionsOpChange,
  } = useRuleConditionFilters(
    widget?.meta?.conditions,
    widget?.meta?.conditionsOp,
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const day = parameters.get('day');
    const month = parameters.get('month');

    if (day && onApplyFilter) {
      onApplyFilter({
        conditions: [
          ...(widget?.meta?.conditions || []),
          {
            op: 'is',
            field: 'date',
            value: day,
          } as RuleConditionEntity,
        ],
        conditionsOp: 'and',
        id: [],
      });
    }

    if (month && onApplyFilter) {
      onApplyFilter({
        conditions: [
          ...(widget?.meta?.conditions || []),
          {
            field: 'date',
            op: 'is',
            value: month,
            options: {
              month: true,
            },
          },
        ],
        conditionsOp: 'and',
        id: [],
      });
    }
  }, [widget?.meta?.conditions, onApplyFilter, parameters]);

  const params = useMemo(() => {
    if (dirty === true) {
      setDirty(false);
    }

      setAllMonths(allMonths);
    }
    void run();
  }, [locale]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (latestTransaction) {
      const [initialStart, initialEnd, initialMode] = calculateTimeRange(
        widget?.meta?.timeFrame,
        {
          start: monthUtils.dayFromDate(monthUtils.currentMonth()),
          end: monthUtils.currentDay(),
          mode: 'full',
        },
        latestTransaction,
      );
      setStart(initialStart);
      setEnd(initialEnd);
      setMode(initialMode);
    }
  }, [latestTransaction, widget?.meta?.timeFrame]);

  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { isNarrowWidth } = useResponsive();
  const title = widget?.meta?.name || t('Calendar');
  const table = useRef<TableHandleRef<TransactionEntity>>(null);
  const dateFormat = useDateFormat();

    if (!widget) {
      throw new Error('No widget that could be saved.');
    }

    const name = newName || t('Calendar');
    updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate({
      widget: {
        id: widget.id,
        meta: {
          ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
          name,
        },
      },
    });
  };

  function onChangeDates(start: string, end: string, mode: TimeFrame['mode']) {
    setStart(start);
    setEnd(end);
    setMode(mode);
  }

  async function onSaveWidget() {
    if (!widget) {
      throw new Error('No widget that could be saved.');
    }

    updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate(
      {
        widget: {
          id: widget.id,
          meta: {
            ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
            conditions,
            conditionsOp,
            timeFrame: {
              start,
              end,
              mode,
            },
          },
        },
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          dispatch(
            addNotification({
              notification: {
                type: 'message',
                message: t('Dashboard widget successfully saved.'),
              },
            }),
          );
        },
        onError: error => {
          dispatch(
            addNotification({
              notification: {
                type: 'error',
                message: t('Failed to save dashboard widget.'),
              },
            }),
          );
          console.error('Error saving widget:', error);
        },
      },
    );
```

```typescript
>;

}): CalendarWidgetSettings {
```

```text
import { useDispatch } from '#redux';
import { useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation } from '#reports/mutations';

export function GoalReport() {
  const params = useParams();
  const { data: widget, isLoading } = useDashboardWidget<GoalCardWidget>({
    id: params.id,
    type: 'goal-card',
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return <LoadingIndicator />;
  }

  return <GoalReportInner widget={widget} />;
}

type GoalReportInnerProps = {
  widget?: GoalCardWidget;
};

function GoalReportInner({ widget }: GoalReportInnerProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const locale = useLocale();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const format = useFormat();
  const { isNarrowWidth } = useResponsive();

  const [start, setStart] = useState(
    monthUtils.dayFromDate(monthUtils.currentMonth()),
  );
  const [end, setEnd] = useState(monthUtils.currentDay());
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<TimeFrame['mode']>('full');
  const [targetAmount, setTargetAmount] = useState(
    widget?.meta?.targetAmount ?? 0,
  );
  const [linkedTag, setLinkedTag] = useState(widget?.meta?.linkedTag);
  const [earliestTransaction, setEarliestTransaction] = useState('');
  const [latestTransaction, setLatestTransaction] = useState('');
  const [allMonths, setAllMonths] = useState<
    Array<{ name: string; pretty: string }>
  >([]);

  const [_firstDayOfWeekIdx] = useSyncedPref('firstDayOfWeekIdx');
  const firstDayOfWeekIdx = _firstDayOfWeekIdx || '0';

  const {
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    onApply: onApplyFilter,
    onDelete: onDeleteFilter,
    onUpdate: onUpdateFilter,
    onConditionsOpChange,
  } = useRuleConditionFilters(
    widget?.meta?.conditions,
    widget?.meta?.conditionsOp,
  );

  // The date picker needs the range of months that have transactions.
  useEffect(() => {
      );
    }
    void run();
  }, [locale]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (latestTransaction) {
      const [initialStart, initialEnd, initialMode] = calculateTimeRange(
        widget?.meta?.timeFrame,
        {
          start: monthUtils.dayFromDate(monthUtils.currentMonth()),
          end: monthUtils.currentDay(),
          mode: 'full',
        },
        latestTransaction,
      );
      setStart(initialStart);
      setEnd(initialEnd);
      setMode(initialMode);
    }
  }, [latestTransaction, widget?.meta?.timeFrame]);

  const updateDashboardWidgetMutation = useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation();

  const title = widget?.meta?.name || t('Personal goal');
  // Uses the unsaved editor state so the report previews changes before the
  // widget is saved.
  const currentAmount = useGoalTotal({
    start,
    end,
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    linkedTag,
  });

  function notifyMissingWidget() {
    dispatch(
      addNotification({
        notification: {
          type: 'error',
          message: t('Cannot save: No widget available.'),
        },
      }),
    );
  }

  const onSaveWidgetName = async (newName: string) => {
    if (!widget) {
      notifyMissingWidget();
      return;
    }

    const name = newName || t('Personal goal');
    updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate({
      widget: {
        id: widget.id,
        meta: {
          ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
          name,
        },
      },
    });
  };

  function onSaveWidget() {
    if (!widget) {
      notifyMissingWidget();
      return;
    }

    if (!isValidGoalTarget(targetAmount)) {
      dispatch(
        addNotification({
          notification: {
            type: 'error',
            message: t('Goal amount must be greater than zero.'),
          },
        }),
      );
      return;
    }

    const { linkedTag: _previousTag, ...previousMeta } = widget.meta ?? {};
    updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate(
      {
        widget: {
          id: widget.id,
          meta: {
            ...previousMeta,
            ...(linkedTag ? { linkedTag } : {}),
            conditions,
            targetAmount,
            conditionsOp,
            timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
          },
        },
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          dispatch(
            addNotification({
              notification: {
                type: 'message',
                message: t('Dashboard widget successfully saved.'),
              },
            }),
          );
        },
      },
    );
  }

  function onChangeDates(
    newStart: string,
    newEnd: string,
    newMode: TimeFrame['mode'],
  ) {
    setStart(newStart);
    setEnd(newEnd);
    setMode(newMode);
  }

  return (
    <Page
      header={
        isNarrowWidth ? (
          <MobilePageHeader
            title={title}
            leftContent={
              <MobileBackButton onPress={() => navigate('/reports')} />
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <PageHeader
            title={
              widget ? (
                <EditablePageHeaderTitle
                  title={title}
                  onSave={onSaveWidgetName}
                />
              ) : (
                title
              )
            }
          />
        )
      }
      padding={0}
    >
      <Header
        allMonths={allMonths}
        start={start}
        end={end}
        earliestTransaction={earliestTransaction}
        latestTransaction={latestTransaction}
        firstDayOfWeekIdx={firstDayOfWeekIdx}
        mode={mode}
        onChangeDates={onChangeDates}
        filters={conditions}
        onApply={onApplyFilter}
        onUpdateFilter={onUpdateFilter}
        onDeleteFilter={onDeleteFilter}
        conditionsOp={conditionsOp}
        onConditionsOpChange={onConditionsOpChange}
        show1Month
      >
        {widget && (
          <Button variant="primary" onPress={onSaveWidget}>
            <Trans>Save widget</Trans>
          </Button>
        )}
```
